notes.title: Ataegina and Steam
notes.content:
[h3]Hello all!

First things first, thank you all for being here. To be honest I didn't even realized there was a "news" section in the page until someone alerted me to it. My apologies.

[b]So I'll just tell you what I plan to do in the future right?

- Modernize/improve the graphical aspect of the game (Images, animations. UI)

- Add some more content storywise.

- Rethink the combat system.

- Music/Sounds.[/b]

You may ask, why is only Act I here, well it is for now. For structural reasons I decided to build them separatly, that allows players to play Act I while Act II is being polished. 

There's also a plan for a full game download after all is done, so unless I die or something like that don't worry about having only part of the game.

I think that's all for now. Thank you once again.

[i]Cheers!

Kthulian[/i][/h3]
